correctness.rationale: For the exact four-site path and unrestricted repeated-index triadic sum, order parameters factor the 16-term per-node interaction as tau Im(z2 conj(z1)e^-i theta_i). The original four-by-four Jacobian has characteristic polynomial λ(λ+2κ)[λ²+τλ+κτ-2κ²], with gain threshold τ/κ=2; that linear threshold is prior work. Reflection/inversion fixes the two-dimensional (a,b,pi-b,pi-a) slice; its exact reduced equations were checked. With δ=τ/κ-2, center manifold at δ=0 has a=b³/2+O(b5) and slow motion b_dot=κ b³/2+O(b5), demonstrating nonlinear instability at equality. The equilibrium fast equation gives a=-δ b/4+b³/2+..., and slow equilibrium equation 0=-δ/2+b²/2+..., yielding exactly two branches b±=±sqrt(δ)+O(δ^1.5), a±=±δ^1.5/4+O(δ^2.5) for δ>0 and none for δ<=0 near origin. Slow eigenvalue κδ>0 on the two branches; other quotient eigenvalues negative. This establishes subcritical localized index-one saddles, no full global phase portrait.
